title: Spectral Obstructions to Contracting Transport Maps on Curved Spaces
summary: Caffarelli's contraction theorem states that the Brenier optimal transport map from the standard Gaussian measure to a more log-concave probability measure is $1$-Lipschitz. Motivated by this theorem, Milman [Mil18] formulated several conjectures for the round sphere and for weighted manifolds satisfying the curvature-dimension condition $\operatorname{CD}(ρ,\infty)$. A contracting transport map as in these conjectures implies a corresponding spectral comparison.
